headline: Approved February 18, 2026 minutes 7-0; discussed finances, harbor projects, and marina rates.
summary: The Harbor Management Authority approved its February 18, 2026 minutes and reviewed updates on recreational revenue, the Harbormaster's activities, hoist pier upgrades, the sailboat auction, and kayak waitlist. The vote on commercial marina rates was postponed to the April meeting, and several other items were discussed without formal action.
decisions: Approved motion to adjourn the meeting, 7-0.
